tldr: Evening batch, Aug 30: OpenAI formally ends its Cursor partnership after the SpaceX takeover — model access winds down Nov 12, and Anthropic's Tom Brown pledges extra compute to keep Claude in Cursor as the safe harbor (Cursor says OpenAI models are only ~5% of traffic). A MATS study finds Claude Code and Codex have no sense of time — both default to ~90-minute estimates and overrate their own work by ~20 points. Hugging Face ships an agent-first hf CLI that detects which coding agent is driving it and auto-installs a Claude Code skill, and closes the robotics data loop with Strands Agents + LeRobot. A Bocconi experiment (1,053 students) shows GPT-4o-boosted grades overstate real skill. And Hermes' compaction design becomes the industry standard — PR #87326 adds a recall-eval harness plus lean mode.

articles.title: OpenAI cuts Cursor off — and Anthropic steps in
articles.summary: OpenAI ends Cursor model access Nov 12 after SpaceX takeover; Anthropic pledges compute to keep Claude in Cursor — the coding-tool battleground shifts.

articles.title: AI agents have no sense of time — study
articles.summary: MATS study: Claude Code and Codex default to ~90-min estimates on 200+ tasks, overrate their work by ~20 points; Claude off by 3x, Codex 6-10x.

articles.title: Hugging Face ships agent-first hf CLI
articles.summary: HF's new CLI detects the driving coding agent, reshapes output for agents, auto-installs a Claude Code skill — agents as first-class Hub users.

articles.title: The skills AI can fake best are the ones that earn top grades
articles.summary: Bocconi study (1,053 students): GPT-4o lifted assignment grades ~1 point on a 5-point scale — but whether anyone learned anything wasn't tested.

articles.title: Hermes compaction becomes the industry standard
articles.summary: Competitors converge on Hermes' compaction design; PR #87326 adds a recall-eval harness plus lean mode — compaction quality becomes auditable.

articles.title: Hugging Face Strands Agents + LeRobot close the robotics data loop
articles.summary: HF's Strands Agents + LeRobot + Storage Buckets: record, train, and deploy embodied-AI models from one platform — robotics data loop closed.

articles.title: Fine-tuned 0.8B local model matches frontier on dictation cleanup
articles.summary: SpeakoFlow Mini: Apache-2.0 Qwen3.5-0.8B fine-tune for dictation cleanup matches a hosted frontier model on this narrow task.
